listing.title: Tree Farm Season Shirt, Watercolor Red Truck Christmas Tree Tee, Vintage Truck Holiday Shirt, Farmhouse Christmas Gift for Her
listing.description: A watercolor vintage red pickup headed home with a fresh-cut fir standing in the bed (a red bow tied on), snowy pines on both sides and soft snow on the ground.
